ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which predator is atop this food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a food chain/food web diagram. The left side is labeled “Leaves & Algae”, with arrows pointing to “Mayflies”, “Stoneflies”, and “Caddis Flies” in the middle. These insect-related nodes then point by arrows to “Trout” on the right, and after “Trout” there is another arrow pointing to “Humans” on the far right. Reasoning: In a food chain, the organism that the arrows ultimately point to is at the highest trophic level, that is, the apex predator. In this diagram, the arrows continue from “Trout” to “Humans”, so the predator at the top of the food chain is humans.
